product.title: Grand Entrance Grand Canyon Jeep Tour

description.text: A two-hour Jeep tour from Tusayan covers the classic South Rim introduction with transport included from local hotels. Grandview Point overlooks and an IMAX ticket at the visitor center round out a compact first visit to the canyon.

highlights: Two-hour open-air Jeep tour of the South Rim
Hotel transport included from Tusayan properties
Stop at Grandview Point for canyon panoramas
Grand Canyon IMAX movie ticket included

start.description: Pickup from Tusayan hotels for transfer to the Jeep staging area near the National Geographic Visitor Center.

end.description: Return transport to your Tusayan hotel after the Jeep loop and IMAX pickup.
